task: Predict STK11 mutation status in lung adenocarcinoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, focus on differences in gland formation, mucin production, stromal reaction, necrosis, and the degree of inflammatory infiltration that may separate these groups.

classes.0: STK11 wildtype lung adenocarcinoma with more conventional gland-forming morphology and less distinctive immune-cold appearance.
classes.1: STK11 mutant lung adenocarcinoma showing relatively immune-poor tumor stroma, variable mucinous change, and less inflamed morphology.
